info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions API provides healthcare professionals with the ability to retrieve and analyze potential interactions between prescribed medications. By offering detailed insights about prescription interactions, this API supports safer medication practices and helps avoid adverse drug interactions. Common consumers of this API include pharmacists and healthcare providers who need to assess patient medication plans. With a focus on enhancing patient safety, this resource is essential for ensuring effective medication management.

get.summary: Retrieve drug interaction information for prescriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information about potential drug interactions within prescriptions. It serves as a crucial tool for healthcare applications, assisting in safe medication practices by highlighting possible conflicts between prescribed drugs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve interactions related to prescriptions. The request should include the necessary parameters in JSON format to ensure accurate responses regarding potential drug interactions.
